jobs.title: Support Staff (Lascar)
jobs.organization: National Aerospace Science & Technology Park (NASTP), Aviation City Pakistan (ACP)
jobs.description:
Support Staff (Lascars) shall provide essential logistical, office, site, file-movement, and routine operational assistance to the PMU and project teams. Eight incumbents may be deployed according to site and office requirements
Qualification: Basic literacy and physical fitness appropriate to assigned field and office support duties.
Relevant practical experience in construction, office support, logistics, or institutional environments shall be preferred.
Ability to follow instructions and work reliably in a disciplined environment.
Assist in the safe movement and handling of files, drawings, correspondence, samples, small tools, materials, and office supplies.
Support routine site and office logistics, meeting arrangements, document delivery, and general facilitation duties.
Assist during inspections, stock checks, record movement, store-related activities, and other supervised operational tasks.
Maintain cleanliness and basic orderliness of assigned office, meeting, record, and support areas.
Follow safety instructions, access controls, discipline, and the established chain of command at all times.
Perform other lawful support duties assigned for continuity of PMU and project operations

jobs.title: Computer Operator
jobs.organization: National Aerospace Science & Technology Park (NASTP), Aviation City Pakistan (ACP)
jobs.description:
The Computer Operator shall provide digital data, document-processing, reporting, and information-management support to the PMU. Six incumbents may be assigned across project locations and PMU functions according to workload requirements
Qualification: Intermediate or bachelor’s degree with relevant computer, information technology, or office automation training.
Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in data entry, computer operations, reporting, or digital record management.
Good working knowledge of spreadsheets, word processing, presentations, scanning, and routine office software.
Enter, update, verify, and maintain project data, correspondence indexes, progress records, cost information, issue logs, and other approved digital registers.
Prepare formatted letters, reports, presentations, spreadsheets, summaries, dashboards, and routine printouts for review.
Scan, organize, name, store, retrieve, and back up electronic records in accordance with approved file structures and access controls.
Maintain data relating to site activities, procurement and contracts, payments, inspections, materials, manpower, and project reporting.
Check data completeness and accuracy and promptly flag inconsistencies, duplicate entries, or missing source documents.
Provide routine computer, printing, presentation, and electronic-record support during meetings, reviews, and reporting cycles

jobs.title: Assistant
jobs.organization: National Aerospace Science & Technology Park (NASTP), Aviation City Pakistan (ACP)
jobs.description:
The Assistant shall provide administrative, correspondence, documentation, coordination, and
office support to the PMU. Five incumbents may be assigned across management, contracts,
finance, site, and general administration according to operational requirements.
Qualification: Intermediate or bachelor’s degree in Administration, Commerce, Business, Office Management, or a related discipline.
Minimum 3 years of relevant administrative, project-support, or office-management experience.
Working knowledge of correspondence, filing, basic spreadsheets, word processing, and record management.
Prepare, receive, register, route, file, retrieve, and archive official correspondence, submissions, approvals, minutes, and reports.
Maintain assigned registers, trackers, files, attendance records, meeting schedules, action lists, and administrative documentation.
Support preparation and compilation of tender, contract, payment, progress, inspection, and management-reporting documents.
Arrange meetings, record minutes, follow up assigned actions, and coordinate routine communication with internal and external stakeholders.
Assist with office logistics, supplies, record movement, scanning, photocopying, dispatch, and other administrative requirements.
Maintain confidentiality, document integrity, and timely completion of assigned tasks in accordance with PMU procedures.

jobs.title: Quantity Surveyor
jobs.organization: National Aerospace Science & Technology Park (NASTP), Aviation City Pakistan (ACP)
jobs.description:
The Quantity Surveyor shall be responsible for measurement, BOQ administration, cost verification, interim payment support, variation valuation, and commercial cost tracking for the projects
Qualification: Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering, or a related discipline.
Minimum 4 years of relevant experience in quantity take-off, cost estimation, measurement, and construction valuation.
Working knowledge of BOQ administration, measurement standards, interim payments, and variation assessment.
Verify quantities against approved drawings, BOQs, site measurements, specifications, and executed works.
Prepare and review quantity take-offs, measurement sheets, valuation statements, progress quantities, and cost comparisons.
Support assessment of contractor bills, supplier claims, and measurement-based payment recommendations.
Evaluate the cost effect of variations, change orders, scope adjustments, omissions, and additional works.
Maintain records of executed, pending, and forecast quantities, commitments, and cost exposures.
Coordinate with project, contracts, finance, consultants, and contractors to maintain commercial accuracy and defensible records.

jobs.title: Manager Finance
jobs.organization: National Aerospace Science & Technology Park (NASTP), Aviation City Pakistan (ACP)
jobs.description:
The Manager Finance shall be responsible for financial planning, budgetary control, expenditure oversight, cash-flow management, payment review, and financial reporting for the PMU. The role shall ensure prudent utilization of project funds and compliance with approved financial controls.
Qualification: Professional degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, or a related discipline; a recognized professional certification shall be advantageous.
Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in project finance, cost control, construction accounting, or financial management.
Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, payments, reconciliations, controls, and financial reporting
Prepare and maintain project budgets, cash-flow forecasts, expenditure plans, cost summaries, and periodic financial reports.
Monitor allocations, commitments, liabilities, expenditures, payment projections, and available balances against approved provisions.
Review contractor bills, supplier invoices, reimbursements, and supporting documents before processing through the approved payment pathway.
Coordinate with contracts and quantity surveying functions to assess cost impacts of variations, claims, escalation, and schedule changes.
Maintain financial records, reconciliations, tax and statutory documentation, audit trails, and management-ready financial information.
Advise the Project Manager (Coordinator) on financial risks, funding requirements, variances, and corrective measures.

jobs.title: Manager Contracts
jobs.organization: National Aerospace Science & Technology Park (NASTP), Aviation City Pakistan (ACP)
jobs.description:
The Manager - Contracts shall manage tendering and contract administration for the projects and safeguard the organization’s contractual and commercial interests through disciplined management of obligations, records, notices, variations, claims, and contractual risks.
Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in Law, Engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline. B
Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in procurement, tendering, or contract administration for construction or infrastructure projects.
Strong understanding of contractual procedures, notices, claims, variations, and commercial documentation.
Prepare and coordinate procurement and contracting actions in accordance with approved plans, specifications, budgets, procedures, and delegated powers.
Support preparation and review of tender documents, bid evaluations, recommendations, awards, agreements, and contractual correspondence.
Interpret contractual provisions and advise the PMU on rights, obligations, liabilities, timelines, and compliance requirements.
Manage notices, variations, claims, extension-of-time matters, performance issues, and contract close-out documentation.
Maintain contract registers, securities, insurance records, deliverables, milestones, correspondence, and a contractual risk register.
Coordinate with project, finance, quantity surveying, consultants, contractors, and suppliers on contractual and commercial matters

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager
jobs.organization: National Aerospace Science & Technology Park (NASTP), Aviation City Pakistan (ACP)
jobs.description:
The incumbent shall support the Project Manager (Coordinator) in day-to-day planning, supervision, coordination, and monitoring of project execution. Two incumbents may be deployed across the project locations or assigned functional responsibilities according to implementation requirements.
Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, or a related engineering discipline from a recognized institution.
Minimum 7 years of relevant experience in construction, industrial, building-services, or multidisciplinary project execution.
Practical ability to read drawings, monitor site works, maintain records, and coordinate contractors and consultants.
Coordinate daily site activities covering civil, structural, architectural, steel, electrical, mechanical, ELV, finishing, and allied works.
Monitor work fronts, construction sequencing, manpower, materials, equipment, and progress against approved drawings and schedules.
Review site submissions, method statements, material information, technical queries, inspection requests, and execution constraints for onward action.
Verify site progress, measurements, quality, safety compliance, testing, commissioning, and readiness of completed works.
Coordinate with consultants, contractors, suppliers, PMU staff, and user representatives to resolve interfaces and maintain execution continuity.
Prepare daily and periodic progress reports, issue logs, photographs, risk updates, and recommended corrective actions.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.organization: National Aerospace Science & Technology Park (NASTP), Aviation City Pakistan (ACP)
jobs.description:
The Project Manager (Coordinator) shall head the PMU and provide overall leadership for planning, execution, coordination, monitoring, and close-out of the Project. The incumbent shall ensure achievement of approved scope, time, cost, quality, safety, compliance, and stakeholder requirements
Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline; a master’s degree shall be preferred.
Minimum 15 years of progressively responsible experience in construction or infrastructure project management.
Demonstrated experience in multidisciplinary coordination, contract administration, project controls, and senior stakeholder management
Lead the PMU and establish project execution, reporting, coordination, risk-management, and escalation arrangements.
Coordinate activities across both project locations and maintain liaison with senior management, client representatives, consultants, contractors, and relevant authorities.
Monitor physical and financial progress against approved scope, milestones, budgets, contracts, and implementation plans.
Ensure timely resolution of technical, contractual, financial, procurement, quality, safety, and site-interface issues. e. Review management reports, critical risks, delays, variations, claims, and corrective actions, and submit recommendations to the competent authority.
Ensure orderly testing, commissioning, documentation, handover, and project close-out in accordance with approved requirements.
